environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance with PostgreSQL RDS (db.t3.medium). The appuser database role has full privileges on the appdb database (GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES). Application is exposed via an NLB (Network Load Balancer) on port 443 with TLS termination, passing raw TCP to the Flask app. No additional middleware or proxy filtering is applied.

config.db_privileges: GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO appuser
config.network: VPC with public subnet, security group allows 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
